topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: delegation-label: contract tests for same-band append, recorded dependency order, and fail-closed missing priority
topic_coverage.delegation_scope: Contract tests prove three behaviors: a new story or bug stays at the end of its P0/P1/P2/P3 band, a dependency or chicken-and-egg is recorded and ordered without an operator prompt, and a missing Priority fails closed.
topic_coverage.delegation_rationale: The operator confirmed the done sentence and did not name a test file or command. The check stays a contract test owned by this story.

questions_posed.outcome_success_criteria: Which rule should auto use? A queue order is the work order and priority is only a label. B priority still sorts, and append means the end of that priority band.
questions_posed.impacted_components: What is a Fall: OPEN stories, OPEN bugs, or both?
questions_posed.constraints_compatibility_risks: When intake sees a dependency or a chicken-and-egg topic, intake picks an order and records the dependency, or intake stops and asks?
questions_posed.priority_scale: Confirm the priority scale stays the existing P0 / P1 / P2 / P3.
questions_posed.done_definition: Confirm: auto works each case in the order from question 1, intake appends each new item at the end unless the chicken-and-egg rule from question 3 applies, and every item is marked on the existing P0/P1/P2/P3 scale.

answer_readings.1: Priority still sorts. Append means the end of that priority band.
answer_readings.3: Intake picks an order and records the dependency. It does not stop to ask.
answer_readings.4: The scale stays P0 / P1 / P2 / P3.

decomposition.why_not_split: One operator outcome: priority-band order, end-of-band append, and intake-recorded dependencies.

placement_decision.rationale: Operator did not name a band for this story. P1 matches other open autonomy stories and leaves in-flight P0 US-0162 ahead. No dependency or chicken-and-egg pulls US-0163 earlier.
placement_decision.position: end of the P1 band by next id US-0163
